response.justification: The candidate is a highly experienced, versatile software engineer (15+ years) with strong distributed-systems and low-latency backend exposure, but the role centers on hands-on modern C++ development for industrial automation with IEC 62443 SDL practices. His C++ experience is limited to a brief stint at National Instruments (2014–2015) and a university project; his recent decade is dominated by TypeScript, Node.js, and DLang web/platform work, with no evident industrial protocol, MQTT, or industrial-cybersecurity background.
strengths: Deep experience with high-performance, low-latency systems (millions of requests/sec at Dunnhumby)
Strong software craftsmanship: TDD, CI/CD, event-driven architectures, mentoring and teaching track record
Broad full-stack and DevOps versatility including Node.js, React-adjacent frameworks, and Kubernetes
concerns: Very limited and dated professional C++ experience (~6 months in 2014–2015)
No IEC 62443, SDL, or industrial-cybersecurity exposure; no MQTT or industrial protocols (Modbus, OPC UA, etc.)
Career trajectory is web/SaaS-focused, misaligned with automation machinery manufacturing domain

key_factors.factor: Strong distributed-systems and performance engineering skills
